title: INTERNATIONAL TRUCK & ENGINE CORPORATION: INTERNATIONAL/BRAKE LIGHTS/CRUISE CONTROL SWITCH (28,010 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  HEAVY DUTY TRUCKS.   THE BRAKE LIGHT SWITCH AND THE CRUISE CONTROL SWITCH ARE MOUNTED IN SUCH A WAY AS TO ALLOW MOISTURE WITHIN THE AIR BRAKE SYSTEM TO COLLECT INSIDE THE SWITCHES.  IF THE MOISTURE IN THE SWITCHES FREEZES, THE BRAKE LIGHTS MAY NOT FUNCTION AND THE CRUISE CONTROL MIGHT NOT DISENGAGE WHEN THE BRAKE PEDAL IS DEPRESSED.

title: IC CORPORATION: AMTRAN/PART 565/VIN (327 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  SCHOOL BUSES.     THESE VEHICLES FAIL TO COMPLY WITH THE REQUIREMENTS OF FMVSS 565, "VEHICLE IDENTIFICATION NUMBER REQUIREMENTS."  THE VEHICLES HAVE THE WRONG MODEL YEAR CODE IN THE VEHICLE IDENTIFICATION NUMBER (VIN).

title: Meritor, Inc.: ARVINMERITOR/DANA BRAKE MASTER CYLINDER (4 affected)
summary: EQUIPMENT DESCRIPTION:  DANA BRAKE MASTER CYLINDER PART NUMBERS MC390275 AND MC390337 MANUFACTURED BETWEEN APRIL 1998 AND APRIL 2000.  THESE MASTER CYLINDERS HAVE AN INCORRECTLY MOLDED BRAKE FLUID RESERVOIR.  THE FLUID RESERVOIR MAY NOT HAVE SLOTS, WHICH ARE DESIGNED TO ALLOW FOR FLUID TRANSFER IN THE MIDDLE PORTION OF THE RESERVOIR WHERE THE BRAKE FLUID WARNING SWITCH IS LOCATED.

title: CARPENTER INDUSTRIES, INC.: CARPENTER/SEAT REINFORCEMENT (3,205 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:    SCHOOL BUSES.  ADDITIONAL REINFORCEMENT BARS WERE INSTALLED WHILE PERFORMING A PREVIOUS SEAT RECALL (98V-238).  THESE BARS WERE INSTALLED INTO THE PROTECTION ZONE ON THE BACK OF THE SEATS.

title: Blue Bird Body Company: BLUE BIRD/WIRING HARNESS CHAFFING (175 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:   SCHOOL AND TRANSIT BUSES EQUIPPED WITH CUMMINS ISC ENGINES.  THE WIRING HARNESS TO THE COMBUSTION AIR INTAKE GRID HEATER CAN CHAFE AGAINST THE ENGINE AND WEAR THROUGH.

title: Keystone RV Company: KEYSTONE RV/TRAILER BREAKAWAY (74 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  FIFTH WHEEL TRAILERS.   THERE IS A LACK OF A GROUND TO THE JUNCTION BOX LOCATED UNDER THE GOOSENECK AND ABOVE THE PIN BOX.  THIS COULD RESULT IN A FAILURE TO ACTIVATE THE BRAKES IN THE EVENT THE FIFTH WHEEL BECOMES DISENGAGED FROM THE TOW VEHICLE.

title: FEATHERLITE LUXURY COACHES: FEATHERLITE/STEERING LEVERS (83 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  MOTOR HOMES EQUIPPED WITH DANA STEERING RELAY LEVERS.  THE LEVERS CAN DEVELOP SURFACE CRACKING.

title: FREIGHTLINER LLC: FREIGHTLINER/ABS ECU (35,405 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  HEAVY DUTY TRUCKS AND SCHOOL BUS CHASSIS BUILT WITH BENDIX AIR ABS WITH AN EC-17 1030R ELECTRONIC CONTROL UNIT (ECU), THERE HAVE BEEN REPORTS OF UNWANTED ABS ACTIVATION AT LOW SPEEDS CAUSED BY 1) CHAFED ABS WHEEL SPEED SENSOR WIRES ON ROTATING PARTS OR 2) A DAMAGED COMPONENT AT THE WHEEL END THAT GENERATES A CERTAIN TYPE OF ERRATIC SENSOR SIGNAL.

title: Indian Motorcycle Company: INDIAN MOTORCYCLE/BATTERY CABLE CHAFFING (184 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  MOTORCYCLES.  POSSIBLE POSITIVE BATTERY CABLE CHAFFING CAN CAUSE THE CABLE TO GROUND TO FRAME, ALLOWING POSSIBLE INTERRUPTION TO THE IGNITION SYSTEM.  MOTORCYCLE CAN CRANK, BUT NOT START.

summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION: HEAVY DUTY TRUCKS BUILT WITH BENDIX AIR ABS WITH AN EC-17 1030R ELECTRONIC CONTROL UNIT (ECU), THERE HAVE BEEN REPORTS OF UNWANTED ABS ACTIVATION AT LOW SPEEDS CAUSED BY 1) CHAFED ABS WHEEL SPEED SENSOR WIRES ON ROTATING PARTS OR 2) A DAMAGED COMPONENT AT THE WHEEL END THAT GENERATES A CERTAIN TYPE OF ERRATIC SENSOR SIGNAL.

title: General Motors, LLC: GM/AIR BAG MODULE (580 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  PASSENGER VEHICLES.  THE AIR BAG SENSING AND DIAGNOSTIC MODULES (SDM) COULD EXPERIENCE A MEMORY ERROR RESULTING IN THE AIR BAGS NOT DEPLOYING IN A CRASH SITUATION.

title: FREIGHTLINER LLC: FREIGHTLINER/SLACK ADJUSTER (524 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  RECREATIONAL VEHICLE CHASSIS.   INTERFERENCE CAN OCCUR BETWEEN THE STEER AXLE SLACK ADJUSTERS AND THE AXLE KNUCKLE POST DURING A FULL WHEEL CUT WITH THE BRAKES APPLIED.

title: FREIGHTLINER LLC: FREIGHTLINER/REAR WHEEL COVERS (3,400 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:  RECREATIONAL VEHICLE CHASSIS.  THE COMPONENTS THAT RETAIN THE REAR AXLE WHEEL COVERS MAY HAVE BEEN DAMAGED DURING INSTALLATION.

title: TRW COMMERCIAL STEERING SYS.: TRW STEERING SYSTEMS/DRAG LINK ASSEMBLY (34,457 affected)
summary: EQUIPMENT DESCRIPTION:  DRAG LINK ASSEMBLIES MANUFACTURED BY TRW.  EACH DRAG LINK ASSEMBLY CONTAINS TWO 20-EDL MODEL BALL SOCKET ASSEMBLIES.  CERTAIN OF THE BALL-SOCKET BEARINGS HAVE A BELOW SPECIFICATION CASE DEPTH AND/OR HARDNESS WHICH CAN LEAD TO PREMATURE DETERIORATION OF THE SOCKET.  THESE BEARINGS WERE PRODUCED BETWEEN JULY 5 AND OCTOBER 3, 1999.

title: Blue Bird Body Company: BLUE BIRD/STEERING SHAFT PINCH BOLTS (1,581 affected)
summary: VEHICLE DESCRIPTION:   SCHOOL AND TRANSIT BUSES.   THESE BUSES COULD HAVE IMPROPERLY INSTALLED OR MISSING PINCH BOLTS IN THE STEERING SHAFT ASSEMBLIES.

title: CPSC, KFC Corporation Announce Recall of Toy Included With KFC Kids Meals
summary: The bottom of the container can fit over a child's nose and mouth, which could pose a suffocation hazard to children under three years of age. Units: About 425,000.

title: CPSC, Williams-Sonoma Inc. Announce Recall of Portable Gas Grills
summary: The grills can be difficult or impossible to turn off and the temperature control can malfunction. This poses fire, burn, and explosion hazards to consumers. Units: About 950.

title: CPSC, Minoura Announce Recall of Bicycle Indoor Training Stands
summary: These stands allow regular bicycles to be used as stationary bicycles. The flywheels, which are red or blue, can fracture in use. Metal pieces of broken flywheels can hit riders or bystanders, causing cuts and bruises. Units: About 29,500.

title: CPSC, Polaris Industries Inc. Announce Recall of All-Terrain Vehicles
summary: The throttles on these ATVs can stick, preventing the ATV from slowing down when released. This can cause the vehicle to lose control and crash, resulting in severe injury or death. Units: About 13,600.

title: CPSC, Kmart Announce Recall of Children's Swim Masks
summary: The mask's glass lens can break into sharp pieces, causing lacerations to a child's face, eyes or hands. Units: About 85,550.

title: CPSC, Safety 1st Announce Recall to Repair Baby Walkers
summary: Babies can lose their lower teeth when the teeth are caught in parts of the three-spoke steering wheels. Also, on some of these walkers, the telephone could break apart, releasing small parts and posing a choking hazard. Units: About 170,000.

title: CPSC, Appliance Co. of America LLC Announce Recall of Juice Extractors Sold at Kmart
summary: The juice extractor's filter and lid can break apart, and project metal and plastic into the air, causing injuries to nearby consumers. Units: About 229,000.

title: CPSC, Rashti & Rashti Announce Recall of Pacifier Clips
summary: The metal clip and the small rivet that attaches the clip to a small, stuffed animal on the pacifier holder can break apart easily, exposing babies to small parts. This poses a choking and aspiration hazard to babies. Units: About 12,700.

title: CPSC and The Coleman Co. Announce Recall of Gas Grills
summary: A sharp edge on the metal heat shield below the control panel of the grill can cause lacerations to the hands, wrists or arms. Units: About 86,000.

title: Gel Pens Recalled by Colorbök
summary: Because these pens contain an extra spring, the end caps can shoot off with great force, posing a risk of eye and facial injuries. Units: About 7,400.

title: Weather Radios Recalled by Oregon Scientific
summary: The radio can fail to decode certain signals broadcast by the National Weather Service or can provide incorrect warnings of severe weather that puts lives and property at risk. Units: About 10,000.

title: CPSC, Fisher-Price Announce Recall of Swings and Toys
summary: Life & Lock Swings: Children can maneuver out of the restraints and fall out of the swings, resulting in serious injuries. Get Up & Go Walkers: Young children leaning forward on the front of the toys can tip them over and fall. Also, the windshield wipers on some of the toys, which stick out, can in

title: CPSC, Kids Line Inc. Announce Recall to Repair "Le Cradle" Bassinets
summary: Infants can become entrapped in an opening between the bassinet's side and mattress platform and suffocate. Additionally, fabric can separate from the metal frame. Infants can be injured when they scrape against or become caught in the frame. Units: About 46,000.

title: CPSC, The Penray Companies Inc. Announce Recall of Starting Fluid
summary: The starting fluid is extremely flammable and the leaking fluid poses a fire hazard. Direct contact with the product also can irritate the consumer's eyes and skin. Units: About 113,000.

title: Girl's Nightshirts Recalled by the William Carter Co.
summary: The nightshirts, which fail to meet federal children's sleepwear flammability standards, could ignite easily and present a serious risk of burn injuries in violation of the Federal Flammable Fabrics Act. Units: About 1,000.

title: Swivel Rocker Chairs Recalled by Tropitone Furniture
summary: The base of the chair can crack, causing the person seated in the chair to fall. Units: About 1,440.

title: CPSC, Playskool Announce Recall to Replace Busy Poppin' Pals Toys
summary: Small springs inside the toy can break loose, posing a choking and laceration hazard to young children. Units: 420,000.

title: CPSC, Manco Products Inc. Announce Recall to Repair of Go-Karts
summary: These go-karts have guards designed to help prevent entanglements, but riders' long hair or loose clothing still can become entangled in partially exposed rotating components behind the drivers' seats, causing death or serious injury. Units: About 91,000.

title: CPSC, Empire Industries Announce Recall of Children's Riding Vehicles
summary: The vehicles' battery chargers can overheat, presenting fire and injury hazards to children. Units: About 113,000.

title: CPSC, Fisher-Price Announce Recall of Children's Riding Vehicles
summary: The foot pedals, which activate the ride-ons, can stick in the "on" position. Children can be injured when the motorcycle ride-ons fail to stop and strike other objects. Units: About 218,000.

title: CPSC, Tek Nek Toys Announce Recall of Children's Riding Vehicles
summary: The vehicles' battery charger or wires can overheat, presenting fire and injury hazards to children. Units: About 294,000.

title: CPSC, R4 Technical Center Announce Recall of Propane Cylinders
summary: These cylinders can have missing or damaged internal seals in the cylinder valves. Propane can leak, posing a risk of fire, explosion and burn injuries. Units: 4,700.

title: CPSC, Fazoli's Announce Recall of Toys Included with Kids Meals
summary: The bottom of the container can fit over a child's nose and mouth, which could pose a suffocation hazard to children under 3 years of age. Units: About 310,000.

title: CPSC, KinderkidsTM Announce Recall of Inflatable Playrings for Babies
summary: When a baby leans his face against the side of the playring, the soft surface covers the baby's nose and mouth, restricting airflow, and posing the risk of suffocation. Units: About 18,000.

title: CPSC, The Children's Place Announce Recall of Shirts and Rompers
summary: The buttons can come off, posing a small parts choking hazard to young children. Units: About 120,000.

title: Historical eruption: VEI 3, Arenal, Costa Rica (2000-08-23)
summary: A significant volcanic eruption on 2000-08-23. 2 deaths. From NOAA NCEI's significant volcanic eruptions database (VEI: the volcanic explosivity index, 0 to 8).
